As Ritchie Bros Auctioneers Com (RBA) Stock Rose, Norris Perne & French Llp Has Increased Stake by $497,785; St Johns Investment Management Company Stake in Apple (AAPL) Has Trimmed as Share Value Declined
May 16, 2018 - By Peter Erickson
Norris Perne & French Llp increased its stake in Ritchie Bros Auctioneers Com (RBA) by 5.33% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Norris Perne & French Llp bought 17,165 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.11% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 339,301 shares of the business services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $10.16M, up from 322,136 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Norris Perne & French Llp who had been investing in Ritchie Bros Auctioneers Com for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $3.55 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.18% or $0.06 during the last trading session, reaching $32.96. About 498,127 shares traded. Ritchie Bros. Auctioneers Incorporated (NYSE:RBA) has declined 4.25% since May 16, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 15.80% the S&P500.
St Johns Investment Management Company Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 9.5% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. St Johns Investment Management Company Llc sold 2,457 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 23,397 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.96M, down from 25,854 at the end of the previous reported quarter. St Johns Investment Management Company Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $916.38 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.91% or $1.71 during the last trading session, reaching $186.44. About 21.16 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on August, 7. They expect $2.19 earnings per share, up 31.14% or $0.52 from last year’s $1.67 per share. AAPL’s profit will be $10.76 billion for 21.28 P/E if the $2.19 EPS becomes a reality. After $2.73 actual earnings per share reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -19.78% negative EPS growth.
